# zgesc2

> Solves a system of linear equations `A * X = scale * RHS` with a general.

<section class="intro">

N-by-N matrix A using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed
by zgetc2.

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```js
import zgesc2 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zgesc2';
```

### Layout API

Takes a storage layout (`order`) and leading dimensions, like CBLAS/LAPACKE.

```js
zgesc2(
    order,
    N,
    A, LDA,
    RHS, strideRHS,
    IPIV, strideIPIV,
    JPIV, strideJPIV,
    scale
) → Complex128Array
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `order` | `Layout` | Storage layout ('row-major' or 'column-major') |
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | LU-factored N-by-N matrix from zgetc2 |
| ↳ `LDA` | `PositiveInteger` | Leading dimension of `A` |
| `RHS` | `Complex128Array` | **in/out** · Right-hand side vector (overwritten with solution) |
| ↳ `strideRHS` | `integer` | Stride for RHS |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Row pivot indices from zgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride for IPIV |
| `JPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Column pivot indices from zgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideJPIV` | `integer` | Stride for JPIV |
| `scale` | `Float64Array` | **out** · Output: `scale[0]` receives the scaling factor |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A.
- `A`: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by ZGETC2: $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$
- `RHS`: On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X.
- `IPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.
- `JPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.
- `scale`: On exit, `SCALE` contains the scale factor. `SCALE` is chosen $0 \le \mathrm{SCALE} \le 1$ to prevent overflow in the solution.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`: `RHS`

**Throws**

- `TypeError` first argument must be a valid order

### Strided (ndarray) API

Takes explicit strides and offsets for every array. Use it for views, sub-matrices and non-unit strides.

```js
zgesc2.ndarray(
    N,
    A, strideA1, strideA2, offsetA,
    RHS, strideRHS, offsetRHS,
    IPIV, strideIPIV, offsetIPIV,
    JPIV, strideJPIV, offsetJPIV,
    scale
) → Complex128Array
```

Solves a system of linear equations `A * X = scale * RHS` with a general.
N-by-N matrix A using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed
by zgetc2.

IPIV and JPIV are 0-based in this implementation.

Matrix shapes are logical (rows × columns). The reference's leading dimension (`LDA`, …) is replaced by the two strides and the offset.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `N` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Order of the matrix A |
| `A` | `Complex128Array`<br><sub>N × N</sub> | LU-factored N-by-N matrix from zgetc2 |
| ↳ `strideA1` | `integer` | Stride of the first dimension of A (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `strideA2` | `integer` | Stride of the second dimension of A (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetA` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for A (in complex elements) |
| `RHS` | `Complex128Array` | **in/out** · Right-hand side vector (overwritten with solution) |
| ↳ `strideRHS` | `integer` | Stride for RHS (in complex elements) |
| ↳ `offsetRHS` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for RHS (in complex elements) |
| `IPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Row pivot indices from zgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideIPIV` | `integer` | Stride for IPIV |
| ↳ `offsetIPIV` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for IPIV |
| `JPIV` | `Int32Array`<br><sub>length N</sub> | Column pivot indices from zgetc2, 0-based |
| ↳ `strideJPIV` | `integer` | Stride for JPIV |
| ↳ `offsetJPIV` | `NonNegativeInteger` | Starting index for JPIV |
| `scale` | `Float64Array` | **out** · Output: `scale[0]` receives the scaling factor |

<details>
<summary>Reference notes for each argument (the reference implementation's own documentation; 1-based indices)</summary>

- `N`: The number of columns of the matrix A.
- `A`: On entry, the LU part of the factorization of the n-by-n matrix A computed by ZGETC2: $A = P \, L \, U \, Q$
- `RHS`: On entry, the right hand side vector b. On exit, the solution vector X.
- `IPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le i \le N$, row i of the matrix has been interchanged with row `IPIV(i)`.
- `JPIV`: The pivot indices; for $1 \le j \le N$, column j of the matrix has been interchanged with column `JPIV(j)`.
- `scale`: On exit, `SCALE` contains the scale factor. `SCALE` is chosen $0 \le \mathrm{SCALE} \le 1$ to prevent overflow in the solution.

</details>

**Returns** `Complex128Array`

</section>

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   `zgesc2()` corresponds to the reference LAPACK routine [`ZGESC2`](https://github.com/Reference-LAPACK/lapack/blob/v3.12.0/SRC/zgesc2.f).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

```js
import Complex128Array from '@stdlib/array/complex128/lib/index.js';
import Float64Array from '@stdlib/array/float64/lib/index.js';
import Int32Array from '@stdlib/array/int32/lib/index.js';
import reinterpret from '@stdlib/strided/base/reinterpret-complex128/lib/index.js';
import zgesc2 from '@rreusser/blahpack/lapack/base/zgesc2';

// A 2x2 LU-factored complex matrix (column-major, from zgetc2):
const A = new Complex128Array( [ 4.0, 1.0, 0.353, 0.412, 2.0, -1.0, 1.882, 0.029 ] ); // eslint-disable-line max-len
const RHS = new Complex128Array( [ 10.0, 3.0, 7.0, 4.0 ] );
const IPIV = new Int32Array( [ 0, 1 ] );
const JPIV = new Int32Array( [ 0, 1 ] );
const scale = new Float64Array( 1 );

zgesc2.ndarray( 2, A, 1, 2, 0, RHS, 1, 0, IPIV, 1, 0, JPIV, 1, 0, scale ); // eslint-disable-line max-len

const view = reinterpret( RHS, 0 );
console.log( 'Solution (re/im interleaved):', Array.prototype.slice.call( view ) ); // eslint-disable-line no-console, max-len
console.log( 'Scale:', scale[ 0 ] ); // eslint-disable-line no-console
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->

<section class="reference-notes">

## Reference notes

The mathematical description from the reference LAPACK 3.12.0 source of `ZGESC2`. Indices are the 1-based Fortran indices of the source.

### Purpose

ZGESC2 solves a system of linear equations

$A \, X$ = scale\* `RHS`

with a general N-by-N matrix A using the LU factorization with complete pivoting computed by ZGETC2.

</section>
